entries.name: AdGuard Home
entries.summary: Block ads and trackers for every device on your network.
entries.description:
A network-wide ad and tracker blocker that works as your home DNS server.
Because other devices depend on it, this Node keeps a fixed address and
starts AdGuard Home before anything else.

entries.name: Immich
entries.summary: Back up and browse your photos and videos, with search by faces and things.
entries.description:
Immich keeps your photos and videos on your own Nodes. The phone apps back
them up as you take them; the web page browses them by date, place, people
and what is in them, found by its own machine learning.

components.name: server
redis
database
components.quadlet:
[Container]
Image={{ .Image }}
Environment=POSTGRES_PASSWORD={{ .Settings.DB_PASSWORD }}
Environment=POSTGRES_USER=postgres
Environment=POSTGRES_DB=immich
Environment=POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS=--data-checksums
Volume={{ .Volumes.database }}:/var/lib/postgresql/data:Z
ShmSize=128m

entries.name: Jellyfin
entries.summary: Stream your movies, shows and music to any device.
entries.description:
Jellyfin is a free media system. Point it at your films, series, music and
photos and watch them from your TV, phone or browser.

entries.name: Minecraft Server
entries.summary: A Minecraft Java Edition server for you and your friends.
entries.description:
Runs a Minecraft Java Edition server (vanilla by default) that players
on your network can join at this Node's address. Turn on "Reachable from
the internet" in the Console to let friends elsewhere join too; the Node
asks your router to forward the game port for you.

settings.label: I accept the Minecraft End User License Agreement (minecraft.net/eula)
Message shown in the server list

entries.name: Uptime Kuma
entries.summary: Know when your websites and services go down.
entries.description:
A self-hosted monitoring tool with a friendly dashboard. Add the things you
care about and get notified when they stop responding.
